summary: Classover Holdings filed an 8-K announcing a ChEF Purchase Agreement with Chardan Capital Markets LLC, under which the Company may sell up to $100 million of newly issued Class B common stock at a 4% discount to the volume-weighted average price. The Company controls timing and amount, subject to conditions including an effective registration statement. The corresponding Registration Rights Agreement provides for liquidated damages if filing deadlines are missed. This at-the-market equity facility is classified as a capital-return transaction due to its equity issuance structure under a committed facility. Watch for regulatory effectiveness and stock overhang.
